project.name: Module-map deployments
project.description: Compare native v1/v2/v3 paired deployment maps, explicit resource copying and declared module-edge rewrites, with version-specific source validation/repair, semantic planning refusals, native asset hashes and independent offline builds.

entries.name: Validate v1 JSON source syntax
entries.description: Validate original JSON syntax and selected-version module-map semantics without reading assets or preparing a deployment plan.

entries.name: Inspect v1 source structure
entries.description: Inspect the generic imported CEM source structure and original ranges; this is not a typed module-map AST or an execution plan.

entries.name: Format v1 map source
entries.description: Apply the native tabular JSON source formatter with exact expected bytes; formatting grants no deployment or read authority.

entries.name: Repair v1 JSON syntax
entries.description: Restore the missing outer object brace after the original native EOF diagnostic; the repaired map then passes selected-version semantic validation.

entries.name: Build the v1 mapped deployment
entries.description: Lower the real v1 paired-map contract, copy only declared resources and rewrite the authored HTML import map; the sandboxed preview never executes those modules.
